notes: Memory & Relationships + Control Room: citizens now build durable directional relationship history from real face-to-face conversations, use bounded social memories during planning and dialogue, and preserve raw history without turning conversation claims into physical truth. The interface now keeps Visit visible in a right-side Control Room, moves Region/Stores/Structures/History/Updates out of the bottom drawer, and improves map readability with distance-derived spacing, route labels, citizen initials/clusters, and clearer traveler/visitor separation.
